headline: Four new faces to join cabinet tonight in major reshuffle
summary: BNP-led government expands cabinet as Mirza Fakhruzzaman Chowdhury is elected President, triggering a redistribution of ministerial portfolios.
details: The BNP-led government is undergoing a cabinet reshuffle and expansion today, Friday, August 21, marking six months of its administration.
Four new members are set to take their oath of office at Bangabhaban at 7:00 PM, following the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President Mirza Fakhruzzaman Chowdhury.

The new inductees include BNP Standing Committee member Dr. Abdul Moyeen Khan, BJP Chairman Barrister Andaleeve Rahman Partho, Bandarban MP Saching Pru Jerry, and Gaibandha-4 MP Mohammad Shamim Kaiser Lincoln.
Due to President Mirza Fakhruzzaman Chowdhury's new role, his previous portfolio of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives will be redistributed.
The Prime Minister is also considering changes to several other ministries, including the redistribution of portfolios for both ministers and state ministers.
caption:
Four new ministers are joining the cabinet tonight. A major reshuffle is underway as a new President is sworn in.

The BNP-led government is undergoing a cabinet reshuffle and expansion today, Friday, August 21, marking six months of its administration.

Four new members are set to take their oath of office at Bangabhaban at 7:00 PM, following the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President Mirza Fakhruzzaman Chowdhury.

The new inductees include BNP Standing Committee member Dr. Abdul Moyeen Khan, BJP Chairman Barrister Andaleeve Rahman Partho, Bandarban MP Saching Pru Jerry, and Gaibandha-4 MP Mohammad Shamim Kaiser Lincoln.

Due to President Mirza Fakhruzzaman Chowdhury's new role, his previous portfolio of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives will be redistributed.

The Prime Minister is also considering changes to several other ministries, including the redistribution of portfolios for both ministers and state ministers.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul pays homage to Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia
summary: The 23rd President of Bangladesh, elected with 255 votes, visited the graves of the BNP founder and former Prime Minister before his official oath-taking ceremony.
details: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.
He was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh yesterday, Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct election.
Before taking his official oath as the head of state this evening at Bangabhaban, the former BNP Secretary General visited the graves of his party's founder and long-time political ally.
The visit took place following Friday prayers, as the President-elect sought to honor the legacy of the party's leadership before assuming his new role.
caption:
Before taking the oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh, Mirza Fakhrul visited the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.

President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.

He was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh yesterday, Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct election.

Before taking his official oath as the head of state this evening at Bangabhaban, the former BNP Secretary General visited the graves of his party's founder and long-time political ally.

The visit took place following Friday prayers, as the President-elect sought to honor the legacy of the party's leadership before assuming his new role.
